Peter –

I wanted you to get this update from me: **Ballots are still being counted, and right now, it’s still too close to call.**

We are going to do everything we can to make sure every single vote is counted in this race.

But I’ll be honest: That is going to take time – and plenty of resources that we don’t currently have.

As we fight to make sure every ballot is counted, we’re going to remain the top target of the DC establishment.

We put everything we had into winning this race, so I’m counting on your help to fight back against their attacks.

It looks like we’re in this for the long haul, so I need your help to sustain our fight until every vote is counted.

From the very beginning, this campaign has been powered by grassroots donations from people like you. I’m proud of that fact, but it means it’s going to take lots of us to stand up to their pressure in the coming days.

That’s why I have to ask:

**[If you can afford it today, please pitch in anything you can to my and Patty Murray’s campaign at this critical moment. It all adds up to help us keep fighting.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/142915215/658472727/164085866?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk746-bu-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDM4NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxZTg1OTRkYi1hYmQ4LWYxMTEtYmY1Yi0wMDBkM2E1NDQ0MmUiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=fGmpBmdtieaizcQqxGSD468gElQxON5VRo5kx027u8Y=)**

| | _Friend, _ Yesterday was a tough, sobering election day across the country, and we know how disappointing many of the outcomes are for conservatives nationwide. Even in a difficult national environment, grassroots patriots here in Big Sky Country fought for every single vote. Thanks to your grit and dedication, Kurt Alme defeated Seth Bodnar and kept our U.S. Senate seat in Republican hands. Other contests remain tight and are still being finalized, but regardless of where every race lands, we wanted to reach out today simply to say thank you. Whether you knocked doors, made calls, put up yard signs, or supported our candidates from home, you left everything on the field. Your commitment to protecting Montana’s values and defending our way of life is why our state remains resilient. Thank you for your tireless dedication, your hard work, and your continued trust. With sincere gratitude, Montana Republican Party

body:
Only a handful of votes separate Scott Colom from his opponent.
# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/9?t=1&akid=41640%2E3422442%2EouuMBp)
Peter, have you seen what is happening in Mississippi?
**Democratic candidate Scott Colom and incumbent Senator Cindy Hyde-Smith are only separated by a handful of votes, and his race still hasn’t been called.**
Scott is on track to flip this Senate seat _if every single eligible ballot is counted._
His team put everything they had into getting to this point—reaching voters, running ads, and holding events across the state. Now, they have to keep their operation going to protect the vote. That’s his path to victory.
We can cap off this historic election with one more win by making sure his campaign has the resources to keep going until this race is over.

Peter,

I've been waiting a long time to write this email: **the Associated Press has officially called the race in California's 22nd Congressional District, and we won!**
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/142915976/658482507/1733485175?refcode=em-11.4.26-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjIvMS8xMTc1MjUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNjQ1MjA2ZjQtYWRkOC1mMTExLWJmNWItMDAwZDNhNTQ0NDJlIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=82Fg13lU9t7SnxP7K1u_Tw6Lmqs5QYGKuACbGDC555I=)
When I launched this campaign, plenty of people in Washington doubted that a kid who grew up working at the swap meet and his family's auto shop could win this seat.

You helped me prove them wrong, along with hundreds of volunteers and tens of thousands of grassroots donors who believed the Central Valley deserved a representative who answers to working families.

Today I'm thinking about my parents, who came to this country from Mexico hoping their children would have a better life than they did. I'm thinking about my wife Carina, our incredible team, and every person who knocked on a door, made a call, or chipped in when we needed it most.

**This victory belongs to all of us.**

The work begins now. Over the coming weeks I'll be building my team and preparing to take office, and I'll be sending you updates along the way, because I want you with me for every step of this journey to Washington.

Holding this seat will take the same grassroots support that won it, and I hope you'll keep investing in this movement whenever you're able — to keep the organizing team we built running, and to deliver on good jobs, universal healthcare, and clean air and water for our community.

They say it takes a village, but we know it takes a Valley. We're going to Washington together.

With gratitude,

Randy

clean_body: | = Peter, I've been waiting a long time to write this email: the Associated Press has officially called the race in California's 22nd Congressional District, and we won! = When I launched this campaign, plenty of people in Washington doubted that a kid who grew up working at the swap meet and his family's auto shop could win this seat. You helped me prove them wrong, along with hundreds of volunteers and tens of thousands of grassroots donors who believed the Central Valley deserved a representative who answers to working families. Today I'm thinking about my parents, who came to this country from Mexico hoping their children would have a better life than they did. I'm thinking about my wife Carina, our incredible team, and every person who knocked on a door, made a call, or chipped in when we needed it most. This victory belongs to all of us. The work begins now. Over the coming weeks I'll be building my team and preparing to take office, and I'll be sending you updates along the way, because I want you with me for every step of this journey to Washington. Holding this seat will take the same grassroots support that won it, and I hope you'll keep investing in this movement whenever you're able — to keep the organizing team we built running, and to deliver on good jobs, universal healthcare, and clean air and water for our community. They say it takes a village, but we know it takes a Valley. We're going to Washington together. With gratitude, Randy | | = | With deep ties to our community and a lifelong commitment to justice and equity, Randy is running for Congress in California’s 22nd District to bring bold, compassionate leadership to Washington. Hi Peter, Last night, Tennessee voters sent a powerful message: Tennessee Democrats are here, we’re fighting, and we’re winning.
Tennessee Democrats flipped six State House seats and a congressional seat, delivering historic victories up and down the ballot.
* Victoria Broderick: Tennessee’s 4th Congressional District
* Brett Windrow: Tennessee State House District 13
* Bryan Goldberg: Tennessee State House District 18
* Owen Farnsworth: Tennessee State House District 34
* Connie Casha: Tennessee State House District 49
* Allie Phillips: Tennessee State House District 75
* Jesse Huseth: Tennessee State House District 97

**These victories didn't happen by accident. They happened because Tennessee Democrats put in the work, from our candidates, caucuses, and county parties to our organizers and volunteers across the state.** Under our new leadership, the Tennessee Democratic Party has made historic investments in the people and infrastructure it takes to compete and win:
* **470,614 doors knocked** this cycle by Tennessee Democrats.
* **600+ new organizers** trained through our first-of-its-kind TNDP Organizing Hub.
* **500+ poll watchers trained and certified** through our historic Voter Protection Program.
* **All 95 counties organized and active** for the first time in decades.
* **More candidates recruited and supported** , competing in districts Democrats had left uncontested for years.

We are so proud Peter,

Last night, Emerge women led the blue wipeout, from coast to coast. We had more than 700 Emerge women on the ballot in 34 states, the most candidates ever.

As of November 4, **Emerge women have an 83% win rate on races called**.

41% of our candidates were women of the New American Majority — Black, Brown, and Indigenous women, women of color, LGBTQ+ women, young and unmarried women — who collectively had an 86% win rate, three points higher than the network. _At the federal level_ 🌴Emerge elected its first Senator in South Carolina, **Dr. Annie Andrews** , who ran a campaign that made the impossible possible in flipping this seat red to blue. She will be the first pediatrician in the U.S. Senate.

💯Of the races called, **Emerge’s Congressional Caucus of 14 members has a 100% win-rate** including in two must-hold DCCC frontline races (Janelle Bynum, OR-05 and Emilia Sykes, OH-13).

🤸🏽♀️As of now,**Emerge alums have flipped five House races** with one still left to call (AZ-06, where JoAnna Mendoza is leading by 10pts). This includes NC-14 (Lakesha Womack), which Trump won by 16 points, and TN-04, which Trump won by 24 points (Victoria Broderick is winning the seat by 180 votes).

👩🏽⚖️Emerge projects **20 women in the Congressional Caucus in the 120th Congress.** _Statewide wins _
* 🏔️Former Interior Secretary **Deb Haaland** won her race for governor of New Mexico, becoming the first Indigenous woman governor in the country.
* 🌶️In New Mexico, **Deb Haaland** and**Stephanie Garcia Richard** are the first all-Emerge ticket elected to run a state!
* 🏜️**Governor Katie Hobbs** won her reelection in Arizona.
* 🧀In Wisconsin, **Lieutenant Governor-elect Sarah Godlewski** and**Secretary of State-elect** **JoCasta Zamarripa** created an example of the Emerge lift-as-we-climb ethos, where JoCasta stepped up to run for SoS when Sarah stepped up from that position to run for LG. JoCasta will be the first Latina and first out LGBTQ+ person to hold the seat.
* **Molly Gray** in Vermont, **Stephanie Garcia Richard** in New Mexico, and **Sarah Godlewski** in Wisconsin won their races for Lieutenant Governor.
* For attorney general, incumbents **Andrea Campbell** in Massachusetts and **Charity Clark** in Vermont won reelection, while **Nicole Cannizzaro** in Nevada and **Jena Griswold** in Colorado ran for higher office to win this position.
* Secretary of State incumbents **Stephanie Thomas** in Connecticut and **Sarah Copeland Hanzas** in Vermont won their races, as did **Amanda López Askin** in New Mexico, and **JoCasta Zamarripa** in Wisconsin.

_At the state level _ Emerge alums also delivered historic wins at the state legislature level. Our alums helped flip:
* 🍑Georgia House
* 🐺Michigan House (Democratic trifecta)
* 🏎️North Carolina House
* 🔔Pennsylvania Senate (Democratic trifecta)
* ⭐️Texas House
* 🧀Wisconsin Assembly (Democratic trifecta)
* 🦡Wisconsin Senate (Democratic trifecta)
* 🌵And in Arizona, votes are still being counted, but if the lead holds, Emerge women will have built a Democratic trifecta in Arizona, flipping both chambers red to blue!

Peter, because of you, we can train 500+ women a year. Because of you, more than 700 women could run. Because of you, Emerge women did the impossible, flipping Congressional districts in North Carolina and Tennessee that Trump won by as much as 24 points.

And for that, we are grateful. Thank you for rising to the occasion and doing what needed to be done to win this historic election. Onward!

A’shanti F. Gholar
Emerge President & CEO |
|

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/142916000/658485490/-2113420158?source=EM_NBI_JP_20261104_FR_Results_0_6MD_JimmyPanetta_NA_NA_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTkwMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyNGU4NTE5Zi1hZWQ4LWYxMTEtYmY1Yi0wMDBkM2E1NDQ0MmUiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=HuhuNS4BOb5FE__jFYC_2Ytuu_UbEuoa4n0IyUCta60=&emci=3df28464-acd8-f111-bf5b-000d3a54442e&emdi=24e8519f-aed8-f111-bf5b-000d3a54442e&ceid=6108787) | Peter, I am deeply honored and humbled to share that the people of California’s 19th Congressional District again elected me to represent them in the United States Congress. My work in Congress has always been guided by the principle that good governing is good politics. Tonight’s overwhelming results reaffirm that belief, bolster my work, and strengthen my commitment to delivering for the people that I proudly serve. Over the past two years, the division and dysfunction in Washington could lead many across the nation to be disillusioned and disengage from the responsibilities of living in our democracy. However, tonight’s results demonstrate that Americans don’t cower during dark times. Instead, we face our challenges, stand together, and embrace our obligations through the democratic process of voting. By giving us robust Democratic majorities in the House and Senate, you and other American voters also gave us a mandate to govern in the 120th Congress. **This victory doesn't belong to me; it belongs to everyone who chipped in, volunteered at staging sites, made phone calls, knocked on doors, and cast their ballot.** We have a lot of work ahead of us. _**With our agency, we must now set the agenda and provide answers for Americans when it comes to the issues of affordability and accountability. Living up to our Constitutional responsibilities and our system of checks and balances, we will legislate to bring down the cost of living, and, at the same time, we will investigate any and all misdeeds by this Administration. I look forward to upholding my Constitutional oath through my service in the 120th Congress, my willingness to work with anybody who helps me govern, and my will to fight anybody who threatens our democratic values.**_ I got into public service because I believe that our government should solve problems, not create them. As we look ahead to the next two years, I promise to keep bringing that exact work ethic to Congress every single day. **Thank you for your friendship, your trust, and for standing with me.** With gratitude and respect, — Jimmy Panetta

Peter, we did it. **The Lehigh Valley has made history and sent a firefighter to put out the dumpster fire in Washington, D.C.** When I was eighteen, my house burned down, and my mom and I lost just about everything. We settled here in the Lehigh Valley and built our life back piece by piece. I held two, three, sometimes four jobs at a time to cover the bills. Now a kid with no college degree who washed dishes, delivered pizzas, drove a beer truck, plowed snow, coached baseball, and spent twenty years on a fire truck is going to Congress. _Only in the Lehigh Valley and the Poconos, and only in America._ To my union brothers and sisters, to my family, my staff, every volunteer who knocked a door or put a sign back in their yard, and everyone who chipped in what they could to emails like this one: thank you. I owe a debt of gratitude to you all. — Bob

# THANK YOU, GRANITE STATE
Dear friends, While last night’s outcome was not what we worked so hard for, I am incredibly grateful to my husband, John, and our family, our dedicated volunteers, individual donors, supporters, and the more than 100,000 Granite Staters who believed in our campaign. I ran a clean, grassroots campaign in NH-02, and we are proud of what we have done together. **I love you all. You are the best. We started a movement together, and it will go on.** I came to America in pursuit of freedom and the American Dream, and I will never stop fighting for those principles. Our campaign was about giving hardworking Granite Staters a voice, restoring affordability, and holding Washington accountable. For me, that fight does not end with this election. My goal was never about winning a seat in government. It always has been about keeping America the Republic I came here for 38 years ago. I will never let my beloved new country fall, because I have no place to go after the USA. New Hampshire is a very special state with a Live Free or Die spirit. John’s ancestors who fought in the American Revolution are buried here in Charlestown. We live in Weare, the home of the Pine Tree Riot. I will stay involved in politics as an influencer and activist, not as a candidate. I may never run for federal office again, but do not be surprised if you hear from me in the near future. Please follow me on social media: [Facebook](https://us.list-manage.com/TigPdTUNjA2?e=c338950e03&c2id=adf8b61e01be85c238f26a96cfd7c41c), [X](https://us.list-manage.com/jeFuJ0kNeZ2?e=c338950e03&c2id=adf8b61e01be85c238f26a96cfd7c41c), [Instagram](https://us.list-manage.com/8ReMgQ7rI_E?e=c338950e03&c2id=adf8b61e01be85c238f26a96cfd7c41c), and [YouTube](https://us.list-manage.com/5KfLY2v80Je?e=c338950e03&c2id=adf8b61e01be85c238f26a96cfd7c41c). **2028 is critical for New Hampshire and the USA!** **One last favor:** please take down your signs and bring them to the dump. Keep the sticks for future local GOP candidates, or give them to your local GOP committee. I will always fight to keep the spirit of liberty alive in the Granite State!
---
| With love and gratitude,
Lily Tang Williams
Republican Congressional Nominee NH-02

clean_body: | | | | | | | THANK YOU, GRANITE STATE Dear friends, While last night’s outcome was not what we worked so hard for, I am incredibly grateful to my husband, John, and our family, our dedicated volunteers, individual donors, supporters, and the more than 100,000 Granite Staters who believed in our campaign. I ran a clean, grassroots campaign in NH-02, and we are proud of what we have done together. I love you all. You are the best. We started a movement together, and it will go on. I came to America in pursuit of freedom and the American Dream, and I will never stop fighting for those principles. Our campaign was about giving hardworking Granite Staters a voice, restoring affordability, and holding Washington accountable. For me, that fight does not end with this election. My goal was never about winning a seat in government. It always has been about keeping America the Republic I came here for 38 years ago. I will never let my beloved new country fall, because I have no place to go after the USA. New Hampshire is a very special state with a Live Free or Die spirit. John’s ancestors who fought in the American Revolution are buried here in Charlestown. We live in Weare, the home of the Pine Tree Riot. I will stay involved in politics as an influencer and activist, not as a candidate. I may never run for federal office again, but do not be surprised if you hear from me in the near future. Please follow me on social media: , , , and . 2028 is critical for New Hampshire and the USA! One last favor: please take down your signs and bring them to the dump. Keep the sticks for future local GOP candidates, or give them to your local GOP committee. I will always fight to keep the spirit of liberty alive in the Granite State! | With love and gratitude, Lily Tang Williams Republican Congressional Nominee NH-02 lily4congress.com Paid for by Lily4Congress Committee | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | Copyright © 2026 LILY4CONGRESS COMMITTEE, All rights reserved._

name: Swing Left
subject: The Mississippi Senate race is neck-and-neck
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Swing Left, [swingleft
body:
Over the coming days, provisional ballots are going to be counted, and history tells us that those ballots tend to lean toward the Democrat.
#
Hi there,
Democrats may have flipped the Senate last night, but there’s still room to grow our majority!
**In Mississippi, the Senate race between Democrat Scott Colom, an elected district attorney, and Republican incumbent Cindy Hyde-Smith is neck-and-neck, with Scott currently leading by fewer than 100 votes.**
The Mississippi Senate race was on Swing Left’s target map of “Reach” races, but after last night, it's no longer a reach. It’s within our grasp, and the Colom team will need this community’s help to run through the tape.
That’s because over the coming days, provisional ballots are going to be counted. History tells us that those ballots tend to lean toward the Democrat in a race. But many of those belong to voters who need to take steps to “cure” their ballot—the process of identifying minor issues and helping voters correct them—or else their votes won’t count.
Most of those voters don’t know that their ballots will need curing yet, which is why Scott’s team is building an operation of volunteers and organizers to find every one of those voters, tell them what they need to do, and help them get it done before time runs out.
But that kind of operation requires resources for staff, travel, phones, and supplies. And Scott’s campaign spent down their funds ahead of Election Day, which means they need our help to raise money for their ballot-curing effort.
This year, our Big Swing was about winning majorities so large and durable that they can’t be knocked loose. A win in Mississippi would mean another six-year Senate term and a balance of power that shifts even further our way. That’s why this effort is so important.
**Mississippi voters showed up, and now you can help to ensure their voices are heard.**[**Will you make a donation to fund Scott Colom’s ballot-curing team and make sure every Mississippi ballot is counted?**](https://act.swingleft.org/go/27?c0=count-for-colom-2026.XuaVTK&utm_source=ak&%3Butm_medium=em&%3Butm_campaign=campaign&%3Butm_content=20261104-2&%3Brefcode=refcode&t=1&akid=3408%2E1562180%2E-aUde-)
**[Donate $25 »](https://act.swingleft.org/go/27?c0=count-for-colom-2026.XuaVTK&amount=25&utm_source=ak&utm_medium=em&utm_campaign=campaign&utm_content=20261104-2&refcode=refcode&t=21&akid=3408%2E1562180%2E-aUde-)**
Thank you, as always, for everything you do. Let’s grow this majority!
— The Swing Left Team

**Since 2017, Swing Left has channeled the energy of grassroots volunteers and donors to elect Democrats, up and down the ballot, focusing on the most competitive races that can swing the national balance of power.** [**If you’d like to help support our work, you can make a donation using this link.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_sl_footer?refcode=em20261104-2&t=22&refcode2=3408_1562180_-aUde-&akid=3408%2E1562180%2E-aUde-)

Thanks to your incredible grassroots support, I woke up the day after the election to a small lead! Across AZ-02, ballots are still being counted, and if we prevail I will make history as the first Native American ever elected to Congress from Arizona.

name: Aaron Ford
subject: Last night, we made history.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the Committee to Elect Aaron Ford
body:
# [](https://act.fordfornevada.com/go/12?t=1&akid=1272%2E127862%2EWyI69b)
Folks, it’s Aaron Ford. We did it, Nevada!
Last night, we made history. We overcame tens of millions of dollars spent against us, defied the odds, and proved something powerful: **when working people come together, there’s nothing we can’t accomplish.**
But I want you to know something. This victory doesn’t belong to me. It belongs to YOU.
It belongs to the card dealer, the housekeeper, the cook, and the bartender on the Strip who work the late shift so a visitor's night can be perfect, and who deserve a life that's just as good.
It belongs to the nurse in Las Vegas, the teacher in Reno, the miner in Elko, and the rancher in Ely.
It belongs to the seniors who helped build this state and deserve to retire here with dignity.
It belongs to the young people asking whether they can afford to build a life in the state they love.
It belongs to the small-business owners who take risks, create jobs, and keep our neighborhoods moving.
**And it belongs to every Nevada child who deserves to grow up believing the American Dream is still possible.**
I know those struggles because I’ve lived them. _And I promise you, I’ll never forget where I came from or who I’m fighting for._
As your next governor, I’ll fight like hell to lower costs, stand up for working families, and make Nevada a place where everyone has a fair shot at the American Dream.
Thank you for believing in this campaign. You made this possible. And this isn’t the finish line – it’s the beginning of a new chapter for Nevada.
With all my heart, thank you.
Aaron Ford

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is the most important way we keep in touch with people like you, so thank you for reading to the end.
To contribute via check, please make it payable to the "Committee to Elect Aaron Ford" and mail it to PO Box 96003, Las Vegas, NV 89193.

body:

We are going to do everything we can to make sure every single vote is
counted in this race.

But I’ll be honest: That is going to take time – and plenty of resources
that we don’t currently have.

Last night I addressed a crowd of thousands in downtown Atlanta to mark our historic and decisive victory and discuss what's next for our state, our country, and our world.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/4c8a4936-dcf1-4bf3-8b8a-fc83ca640c2c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**[(You can watch my speech here on YouTube.)](https://substack.com/redirect/dcca05ba-2894-4704-b748-736325008dd2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
Here's what I said:
Hello, Atlanta!
Thank you, Georgia.
_Georgia, you did it._
And let me be the first to offer public congratulations to the Governor-Elect of the State of Georgia, Keisha Lance Bottoms.
To every volunteer who poured your heart and soul into this effort and everyone who chipped in so we could face down the dark money Super PACs, thank you.
To Charlie Bailey and his crew at the strongest Democratic Party of Georgia in a generation, thank you.
To my staff, to Ellen and Keenan and Rey and Miryam and Chandra and the best team in American politics, thank you.
To my wonderful wife Alisha and my daughters Eva and Lila, my parents, and my entire family, thank you for your unconditional love and support.
And to the people of the great State of Georgia for the trust you've invested in me to continue representing you in the United States Senate, thank you, thank you, thank you.
**THE FIRST LIGHT OF DAWN IS ON THE HORIZON**
And listen, in sweeping and decisive victories, the American people have rebuked the depravity, corruption, and incompetence of the failed lame duck President Donald J. Trump.
And if, at times these last two years, amidst the ceaseless onslaught of brutality and indecency, you doubted whether our Republic would survive, let tonight's results give you courage that the first light of dawn is on the horizon.
But remember that in living rooms and backyards and at rallies across Georgia these last two years, together we've affirmed that our task is not just to contain one president's wickedness, but to heal the brokenness beneath.
_That this moment is an opening not for restoration, but for reformation._
And so, amidst our celebration tonight, we must acknowledge that the underlying crisis gripping our Republic remains and that therefore our most vital work lies ahead.
**AMERICA 'S FORGOTTEN FAMILIES**
Because while the wealthy and well-lobbied feast on inside information and official favors, America's forgotten families are treated to systemic corporate disrespect and official indifference, working harder and harder while the treadmill just gets faster and steeper, and the bills get higher and higher.
Instead of reading your daughter her favorite book that precious spare hour after work, you're on the phone begging the insurance company to cover the medicine that prevents her seizures.
You report the black mold to your landlord, who doesn't fix the leak, and the ambulance for your toddler's asthma attack is followed by a $3,000 bill.
For too many, home ownership's a fantasy. Family farms face ruin. And while health care's never cost more, plastics invade our bodies, blood, and breast milk. Toxic forever chemicals taint half the country's drinking water, and polluters have been granted fresh license to poison our air.
**ADRIFT IN A GALE**
Abroad, American credibility and leadership are in decay, and the world is rearming for global conflict. And at our grave peril, humanity is fast forgetting the terrible lessons of two World Wars and the Holocaust.
Meanwhile, the titans of Silicon Valley dig bunkers for themselves and warn that the artificial intelligence they're creating risks human extinction.
And amidst these challenges of unprecedented consequence and complexity, though we rightly celebrate tonight's historic victory, the fact is we've been too long mired in a small and selfish politics, bought by big money, unmoored from fixed moral principles, and resigned to intractable division.
In other words, the United States has been adrift in a gale. **But, Georgia, we can and will reclaim control over our own destiny.**
**A NEW MAJORITY**
Tonight, we've struck a necessary and undeniable blow on behalf of justice and progress. And tonight, in Georgia, we've proven not just that unity is possible, but that we can overcome division without sacrificing clarity of purpose.
In every corner of Georgia, this campaign urged the necessity of banning corporate and secret money from politics, of American leadership for peace and human rights around the world, and of guaranteeing health care for every single American.
We committed to continuing the work of bringing Big Pharma, Big Insurance, and Big Tech to heel in the defense of struggling Georgia families.
And on that basis, we built a new majority that extends far beyond party lines, and the foundation for that new majority has been trust -- trust built through years of phone calls to mayors, pastors, and farmers, and trust measured in problems solved together, without concern for ideology or party affiliation.
I thank Republican Mayors Matheson, Smith, and Fry of Valdosta, Tifton, and Toccoa, and the countless other Republican leaders who joined our team. And I thank the hundreds of thousands of independent and Republican voters who joined our winning coalition.
Never doubt that unity is possible.
Even in his final months, Congressman Lewis always reminded us that we all live in one American house. _Do you remember?_ In one world house. He called it the inevitable truth that we're all members of one human family.
And I know many of you have poured yourselves into this campaign, not for my sake or for the sake of the Democratic Party, but because you're so deeply troubled by the pain our fellow human beings are enduring right now -- the terror of a child watching ICE take away her mother, the despair of a cancer patient losing coverage mid-treatment.
But that ache in your heart, that pit in your stomach, that feeling's what reminds us we're all in this together, that we're not just one United States, we're one united people.
_E pluribus unum._ Out of many, one.
And over centuries, despite our sins and through courageous struggle, the flame of American freedom has grown brighter and bolder and given hope to the whole world.
**REAWAKENING**
_We 've stumbled. We almost lost our way. But, Georgia, for all our troubles, let me assure you tonight that, propelled by this historic and undeniable victory, I have no doubt we will overcome them._
And now our task is to reawaken that great national spirit that defeated fascism and established Social Security, that put men on the moon and passed civil rights laws in order to meet the challenges and obligations of our time, because I refuse to accept that my two little girls will grow up in a world as dark and dangerous and cruel as this one threatens to become.
I refuse to accept that Eva and Lila will grow up with artificial friends and teachers in a society where the sick die not because there's no cure, but because they have no money. Where we have enough nuclear weapons to destroy the world a thousandfold, but we refuse to guarantee health care for every citizen. On a poisoned planet, rearming for world war, where human life is cheap, and might makes right.
See, when Eva is old enough to ask why I let this happen, I'm determined to answer truthfully that I didn't.
I'll tell her how the same year she turned five, Georgia overcame every doubt and dirty trick not just to win, but to set a new course for our state and our country and our world.
That we defended voting rights and civil rights at home.
That we restored American leadership toward peace and human rights around the world.
That we finally acted to ban corporate money and secret money from our politics, and that we guaranteed health care for every single American.
Thank you, Georgia.
Tonight, we celebrate this victory, and tomorrow we get back to work.
Thank you so much.

clean_body: Last night I addressed a crowd of thousands in downtown Atlanta to mark our historic and decisive victory and discuss what's next for our state, our country, and our world. | | ---|---|--- | | | Forwarded this email? ? for more Nov 4 | | | | | | | | | Last night I addressed a crowd of thousands in downtown Atlanta to mark our historic and decisive victory and discuss what's next for our state, our country, and our world. | | ---|---|--- Here's what I said: Hello, Atlanta! Thank you, Georgia. Georgia, you did it. And let me be the first to offer public congratulations to the Governor-Elect of the State of Georgia, Keisha Lance Bottoms. To every volunteer who poured your heart and soul into this effort and everyone who chipped in so we could face down the dark money Super PACs, thank you. To Charlie Bailey and his crew at the strongest Democratic Party of Georgia in a generation, thank you. To my staff, to Ellen and Keenan and Rey and Miryam and Chandra and the best team in American politics, thank you. To my wonderful wife Alisha and my daughters Eva and Lila, my parents, and my entire family, thank you for your unconditional love and support. And to the people of the great State of Georgia for the trust you've invested in me to continue representing you in the United States Senate, thank you, thank you, thank you. THE FIRST LIGHT OF DAWN IS ON THE HORIZON And listen, in sweeping and decisive victories, the American people have rebuked the depravity, corruption, and incompetence of the failed lame duck President Donald J. Trump. And if, at times these last two years, amidst the ceaseless onslaught of brutality and indecency, you doubted whether our Republic would survive, let tonight's results give you courage that the first light of dawn is on the horizon. But remember that in living rooms and backyards and at rallies across Georgia these last two years, together we've affirmed that our task is not just to contain one president's wickedness, but to heal the brokenness beneath. That this moment is an opening not for restoration, but for reformation. And so, amidst our celebration tonight, we must acknowledge that the underlying crisis gripping our Republic remains and that therefore our most vital work lies ahead. AMERICA 'S FORGOTTEN FAMILIES Because while the wealthy and well-lobbied feast on inside information and official favors, America's forgotten families are treated to systemic corporate disrespect and official indifference, working harder and harder while the treadmill just gets faster and steeper, and the bills get higher and higher. Instead of reading your daughter her favorite book that precious spare hour after work, you're on the phone begging the insurance company to cover the medicine that prevents her seizures. You report the black mold to your landlord, who doesn't fix the leak, and the ambulance for your toddler's asthma attack is followed by a $3,000 bill. For too many, home ownership's a fantasy. Family farms face ruin. And while health care's never cost more, plastics invade our bodies, blood, and breast milk. Toxic forever chemicals taint half the country's drinking water, and polluters have been granted fresh license to poison our air. ADRIFT IN A GALE Abroad, American credibility and leadership are in decay, and the world is rearming for global conflict. And at our grave peril, humanity is fast forgetting the terrible lessons of two World Wars and the Holocaust. Meanwhile, the titans of Silicon Valley dig bunkers for themselves and warn that the artificial intelligence they're creating risks human extinction. And amidst these challenges of unprecedented consequence and complexity, though we rightly celebrate tonight's historic victory, the fact is we've been too long mired in a small and selfish politics, bought by big money, unmoored from fixed moral principles, and resigned to intractable division. In other words, the United States has been adrift in a gale. But, Georgia, we can and will reclaim control over our own destiny. A NEW MAJORITY Tonight, we've struck a necessary and undeniable blow on behalf of justice and progress. And tonight, in Georgia, we've proven not just that unity is possible, but that we can overcome division without sacrificing clarity of purpose. In every corner of Georgia, this campaign urged the necessity of banning corporate and secret money from politics, of American leadership for peace and human rights around the world, and of guaranteeing health care for every single American. We committed to continuing the work of bringing Big Pharma, Big Insurance, and Big Tech to heel in the defense of struggling Georgia families. And on that basis, we built a new majority that extends far beyond party lines, and the foundation for that new majority has been trust -- trust built through years of phone calls to mayors, pastors, and farmers, and trust measured in problems solved together, without concern for ideology or party affiliation. I thank Republican Mayors Matheson, Smith, and Fry of Valdosta, Tifton, and Toccoa, and the countless other Republican leaders who joined our team. And I thank the hundreds of thousands of independent and Republican voters who joined our winning coalition. Never doubt that unity is possible. Even in his final months, Congressman Lewis always reminded us that we all live in one American house. Do you remember? In one world house. He called it the inevitable truth that we're all members of one human family. And I know many of you have poured yourselves into this campaign, not for my sake or for the sake of the Democratic Party, but because you're so deeply troubled by the pain our fellow human beings are enduring right now -- the terror of a child watching ICE take away her mother, the despair of a cancer patient losing coverage mid-treatment. But that ache in your heart, that pit in your stomach, that feeling's what reminds us we're all in this together, that we're not just one United States, we're one united people. E pluribus unum. Out of many, one. And over centuries, despite our sins and through courageous struggle, the flame of American freedom has grown brighter and bolder and given hope to the whole world. REAWAKENING We 've stumbled. We almost lost our way. But, Georgia, for all our troubles, let me assure you tonight that, propelled by this historic and undeniable victory, I have no doubt we will overcome them. And now our task is to reawaken that great national spirit that defeated fascism and established Social Security, that put men on the moon and passed civil rights laws in order to meet the challenges and obligations of our time, because I refuse to accept that my two little girls will grow up in a world as dark and dangerous and cruel as this one threatens to become. I refuse to accept that Eva and Lila will grow up with artificial friends and teachers in a society where the sick die not because there's no cure, but because they have no money. Where we have enough nuclear weapons to destroy the world a thousandfold, but we refuse to guarantee health care for every citizen. On a poisoned planet, rearming for world war, where human life is cheap, and might makes right. See, when Eva is old enough to ask why I let this happen, I'm determined to answer truthfully that I didn't. I'll tell her how the same year she turned five, Georgia overcame every doubt and dirty trick not just to win, but to set a new course for our state and our country and our world. That we defended voting rights and civil rights at home. That we restored American leadership toward peace and human rights around the world. That we finally acted to ban corporate money and secret money from our politics, and that we guaranteed health care for every single American. Thank you, Georgia. Tonight, we celebrate this victory, and tomorrow we get back to work. Thank you so much. 👋 Wait! Before you go... 👋 | | | | | (C) 2026 Jon Ossoff P.O. Box 450326, Atlanta, GA 31145 ? ?

If you are getting this substack, it is likely because you supported my campaign or other campaigns that experts said were difficult races. Two years ago, we learned that while these races can be difficult, particularly when the tides are working against you, [the message was breaking through](https://substack.com/redirect/5e9dba33-5680-464c-8e93-1a11240c1ea3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
This year, the dam finally burst.
I want to say thank you because to catch lightning in a bottle, which some races require, you have to go out into the storm. And without your support, its impossible for any of us to do it.
And yet, this year, it happened all across the country because you continued to invest and sacrifice in candidates, some of whom won and some of whom last, but all of whom delivered a transformational message that people heard. And if this year shows us anything, it's that the more they hear it, the more they believe.
So thank you, again, for everything.
Lucas

The polls have closed, but this race is not over. Tens of thousands of ballots across CA-07 are still to be counted, and every single one of them deserves to be.

But before anything else, I want to say thank you. From the bottom of my heart, thank you.

[](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfquO38L98SklfBdoDq94y0bmUz2y0R042cuXgtd2CLghMZZ5SXxQlhdSZqkJZi-wbFUg5EInISRMW-CoNp73Kx95_-6p24ftndgFDs9C_RAxY5XOQFKFdNMjLN59E4UtO6FNQeLyuFyQ16joUIo11sp-N7Q5wSJcsaEq-8xTQqXgg1D8nSd53qFUwbHsDmZKgXYDsY_bUVGrnWyLzxtMG8cNscbr04BZpfRfZZQWYuhtg4qUT1ht922im66da5xnkVmTvxO74oQjeZYxZmtZIf8UQDcaFY9n8xm2vqr6tmkHlSNuGAONYnx1-5pNdyys57A/4vh/x7n3AsL4SdyXum2io77NTw/h1/h001.pvmEMObrG5wR6WK4h5QqkIHXQj8uxfnYKYXIJwK7m2c)
Last night, I looked out at a room full of the people who built this campaign — young people who knocked doors after class, seniors who made calls from their kitchen tables, working families who gave five dollars when five dollars was what they had.

We were outspent 8 to 1. We faced a $7 million self-loan from the incumbent and wave after wave of AIPAC-aligned and corporate PAC money pouring in to stop us. We refused every dime of corporate PAC money and ran a people-powered campaign instead. Together, we turned what was supposed to be a safe establishment seat into one of the closest races this district has ever seen.

When you don't come from money, you learn to love and fight harder for everything you have. That's exactly how we ran this race, and it's exactly how we're going to finish it.

**Votes are still being counted, and they will keep arriving in the days ahead. We don't have a final result yet, and we may not for a little while. But I promise you this: we will not rest until every last eligible vote is counted. My team and I will be watching every step of the way, and I'll keep you updated as we go.**

No matter the outcome, no one can take away what we built together. The future is not predetermined — and the world we envision is on her way.

With heart and hustle,

Mai

name: Dan Cox
subject: Thank you from the bottom of our hearts
body:
Valerie and I are overwhelmed with gratitude for each of you. | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/75634997bcda/thank-you-from-the-bottom-of-our-hearts?e=5bb5efcda7)
---
| |
---
| |
# Thank you from the bottom of our hearts.
Dear friend, volunteer and supporter,
It’s hard to fully express the gratitude Valerie and I feel toward the people of Maryland for their support in this election. As I said last night at our election night gathering, we are overwhelmed with gratitude for each and every volunteer, staffer, supporter and voter who worked countless hours, labored and traveled and stood with us and voted for us to help save Maryland. Though the results are difficult to comprehend after personally witnessing millions of Marylanders dissatisfied with our state’s direction over the last 10 months, we will continue to pray for Maryland, Governor Moore, and his family as they lead our state.

Throughout this campaign, I explained that the urgency of affordability for every Marylander cannot be overstated. We worked hard, carried a unifying banner of affordability including tax and fee relief, accountability, public safety and education opportunity, and had over 15 million organic social media views, massive public support with thousands of online positive statements recorded compared with massive negativity for Wes Moore, and won 17 counties of 24 jurisdictions (23 counties plus Baltimore City). We fought hard every day and in the gubernatorial debate for you. We sought to speak for Marylanders who cannot always speak for themselves and we proved in the debate that the issues we all face must be addressed urgently by the next governor. The debate itself was said by observers to potentially have undone Wes Moore's national ambitions.

This election is particularly difficult considering families facing eviction, foreclosure, tax lien sales, and electric shutoff notices; others working double shifts just to pay their bills; no Key Bridge rebuilt, and many questioning whether they can afford to remain in Maryland—a state with the second-worst economy, highest electric bills, and seventh-highest tax burden in the nation.

Claims that the structural deficit is a recent consequence of Washington cuts and terminations are belied by the Moore administration’s January 2024 acknowledgment under President Biden of “looming five-year budget forecast...deficits that balloon to $2.7 billion by 2029,” as reported by Maryland Matters. Governor Moore has known of this serious problem throughout his administration and has not remedied it.

It is especially troubling that Governor Moore confirmed today that raising taxes remains on the table despite extreme overspending and fraud causing a structural deficit exceeding $3 billion.

Maryland families need immediate relief: cut taxes and fees, suspend the gas tax and new FAMLI tax, lower electric bills, return energy fund payments to ratepayers, and urgently bring power plants back online. In 2026 alone, Maryland is on pace for an estimated **2.1 million utility shutoff notices, 330,000 eviction filings, 97,000 foreclosure notices, 40,000 tax lien sale notices, and thousands of vehicle registration suspension notices.** Meanwhile, approximately **19,100 Marylanders with developmental disabilities** face major funding reductions affecting essential care.

**That is more than 2.5 million estimated notices and filings indicating economic stress, while thousands of vulnerable families face uncertainty over essential care.**

Marylanders deserve relief—not more taxes, fees, higher electric bills, and cuts to essential services.

Maryland is our home. Unless action is taken quickly, many Marylanders will continue to lose their homes because of current policies.

Valerie and I will continue praying for and working toward a better future for our state. On behalf of Rob Krop and myself, we thank the people of Maryland and everyone who voted for their trust and support as we continue fighting for a better future for all of us.

clean_body: Valerie and I are overwhelmed with gratitude for each of you. | | | | | | | Thank you from the bottom of our hearts. Dear friend, volunteer and supporter, It’s hard to fully express the gratitude Valerie and I feel toward the people of Maryland for their support in this election. As I said last night at our election night gathering, we are overwhelmed with gratitude for each and every volunteer, staffer, supporter and voter who worked countless hours, labored and traveled and stood with us and voted for us to help save Maryland. Though the results are difficult to comprehend after personally witnessing millions of Marylanders dissatisfied with our state’s direction over the last 10 months, we will continue to pray for Maryland, Governor Moore, and his family as they lead our state. Throughout this campaign, I explained that the urgency of affordability for every Marylander cannot be overstated. We worked hard, carried a unifying banner of affordability including tax and fee relief, accountability, public safety and education opportunity, and had over 15 million organic social media views, massive public support with thousands of online positive statements recorded compared with massive negativity for Wes Moore, and won 17 counties of 24 jurisdictions (23 counties plus Baltimore City). We fought hard every day and in the gubernatorial debate for you. We sought to speak for Marylanders who cannot always speak for themselves and we proved in the debate that the issues we all face must be addressed urgently by the next governor. The debate itself was said by observers to potentially have undone Wes Moore's national ambitions. This election is particularly difficult considering families facing eviction, foreclosure, tax lien sales, and electric shutoff notices; others working double shifts just to pay their bills; no Key Bridge rebuilt, and many questioning whether they can afford to remain in Maryland—a state with the second-worst economy, highest electric bills, and seventh-highest tax burden in the nation. Claims that the structural deficit is a recent consequence of Washington cuts and terminations are belied by the Moore administration’s January 2024 acknowledgment under President Biden of “looming five-year budget forecast...deficits that balloon to $2.7 billion by 2029,” as reported by Maryland Matters. Governor Moore has known of this serious problem throughout his administration and has not remedied it. It is especially troubling that Governor Moore confirmed today that raising taxes remains on the table despite extreme overspending and fraud causing a structural deficit exceeding $3 billion. Maryland families need immediate relief: cut taxes and fees, suspend the gas tax and new FAMLI tax, lower electric bills, return energy fund payments to ratepayers, and urgently bring power plants back online. In 2026 alone, Maryland is on pace for an estimated 2.1 million utility shutoff notices, 330,000 eviction filings, 97,000 foreclosure notices, 40,000 tax lien sale notices, and thousands of vehicle registration suspension notices. Meanwhile, approximately 19,100 Marylanders with developmental disabilities face major funding reductions affecting essential care. That is more than 2.5 million estimated notices and filings indicating economic stress, while thousands of vulnerable families face uncertainty over essential care. Marylanders deserve relief—not more taxes, fees, higher electric bills, and cuts to essential services. Maryland is our home. Unless action is taken quickly, many Marylanders will continue to lose their homes because of current policies. Valerie and I will continue praying for and working toward a better future for our state. On behalf of Rob Krop and myself, we thank the people of Maryland and everyone who voted for their trust and support as we continue fighting for a better future for all of us. name: Grassroots Army
subject: This is only the beginning. 28.2 million impressions and counting last month
body:
Watch this morning’s LIVE. ~28.2 million impressions this month. GrassrootsArmy.org goes LIVE Sunday at 6:00 PM EST.
---
Watch this morning’s LIVE. ~28.2 million impressions this month. GrassrootsArmy.org goes LIVE Sunday at 6:00 PM EST.
| Grassroots Army This is only the beginning.
---
Army — Last night hurt. Say it plain. A lot of good people worked their hearts out for this country, and the scoreboard still went the wrong way. **This is only the beginning.**
One hard night does not define a movement. Success is not final. Failure is not fatal. It is the courage to continue that counts. **Watch this morning’s LIVE** I went LIVE this morning to talk about what happened, what it means, and where we go from here. If you missed it, watch it here: [](https://9l762.r.ag.d.sendibm3.com/mk/cl/f/sh/1t6Af4OiGsDg0fV3Ji0XTonBupr9Lp/AyKaWL40b0bO) [▶ Watch the full LIVE on YouTube](https://9l762.r.ag.d.sendibm3.com/mk/cl/f/sh/1t6Af4OiGsE8LNhTi46Se4r1Iept3t/q_qe7B2h1R_I) **What the numbers say about turnout** Michigan did not match 2024. That gap was decisive.
* **2024 Trump:** 2,816,636 votes
* **2026 Rogers (Senate, ~94% counted):** ~2,123,500 — about **690,000 fewer** Republican votes (**~25% down**)
* **Democrats** also dropped vs Harris — but only about **11%** (~305,000 fewer)
* Overall ballots: **~5.71 million in 2024** → tracking about **~4.9 million** this midterm

If both sides had turned out at their 2024 levels, Republicans were still ahead by roughly Trump’s **~80,000** margin. Staying home made a horrific difference. That is the lesson — not despair. **Activation.** Local. Neighbors. School boards. Townships. Counties. The long fight. **Our reach — still growing** While the map shifted, the Army kept moving. Across **all** our socials over the past month:
* **~28.2 million** total impressions/views (Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, Threads, YouTube, and X)
* Facebook alone: **~23.1 million** impressions across Grassroots Army, Garrett L Soldano, and The Forge
* Instagram **~4.2 million** views · TikTok **~373k** · Threads **~257k** · YouTube **~131k** · X **~126k**
* This past week alone: **1,000+ posts** , **~101,000 reactions** , **~12,600 comments** , **~10.5% engagement**

Big hits this week included the University of Michigan student Reel (tens of thousands of Facebook impressions on both pages) and Father Joseph Morgan’s “Murder is a line” Reel (~32,000 on the Grassroots Army page alone). People are still watching. Still sharing. Still hungry for truth over noise.

We do not quit when the feed is quiet. We do not quit when a race is called. We organize. **GrassrootsArmy.org — LIVE Sunday at 6:00 PM EST** You’ve followed us on social. That is where the fire starts. The website is the home base — and it goes **LIVE Sunday, November 8, 2026 at 6:00 PM EST**. I’ll be going LIVE at that time to release it with you. When **grassrootsarmy.org** goes **LIVE** , the intent is simple:
1. **Enlist** — memberships with numbered cards for life, so this is a real Army, not just a scroll
2. **Equip** — USA print-on-demand merch that funds the fight
3. **Activate** — weekly roundups, hard-hitting content, and ways to get involved in _your_ community — school boards, townships, city halls
4. **Build** — inspire ordinary people to do extraordinary things, with training and resources planned for the future

Coming Soon was never stalling. It was finishing the foundation so when we open the doors, we are ready for the long fight — not just the next news cycle. **What you do now** Pray. Regroup. Then get back to work. Talk to one neighbor. Show up at one local meeting. Share one piece of truth this week. Recruit one person who sat out. We don’t quit. We activate. We organize. We continue to fight. For God and Country,
**Dr. Garrett Soldano D.C.**
Grassroots Army P.S. Mark your calendar: **Sunday at 6:00 PM EST** — grassrootsarmy.org goes LIVE and I’ll be LIVE to release it. Enlist and bring someone with you.
**GJS Investments LLC**
8357 Barony Pt, Mattawan, MI 49071

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com because you subscribed to Grassroots Army updates.
[Unsubscribe](https://9l762.r.ag.d.sendibm3.com/mk/un/v2/sh/1t6AVsdYhqSR1mLJmycafKClcNaT5x/HJyK5dFl4OSL) · grassrootsarmy.org (LIVE Sunday, Nov 8 · 6:00 PM EST)

| Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund My brother defended himself... now he’s charged with murder | | | | | Dear Fellow Patriot,[](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABl7ImQiOjUwNTEsInQiOjc2NywicyI6MTJ9AAwAAAAAA_D_xcBfsPLsZe-M3sK7vPYipGpDb40dtNKIhvBsaXJ6j3iJV_9ZC8mhlvDlMkXc1f9cfjiexl7-lq8I8ojWhaQIndVDEOgLXFbpCIv-eg) Never in a million years did I think I would be writing an email like this. [_**But the truth is, my family and I are out of options. And you're our only hope.**_](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABl7ImQiOjUwNTEsInQiOjc2NywicyI6MTJ9AAwAAAAAA_D_xcBgqMIdbdFW6nLMoT4ClkBL9GI4v6SLydpT0Q0WPSGNdP5Biulo2YA8HxeYhyEiseM5rscrucduo2jjU56_TkWc2tvCpK4s-zosUg)

| | | [](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABl7ImQiOjUwNTEsInQiOjc2NywicyI6MTJ9AAwAAAAAA_D_xcBhx6Dwz3hmZwon5sM9r-8oaXB2Vt-6WWM0gJXHuhW5LYi_tgemnoOKmV9CpkfNoHUAjiiIlj_S_DU4vUIXJCw5M71c7nPN8D0Udw)
---
This is a photo of my brother, Anthony DeLustro. Anthony spent more than 20 years serving citizens as an NYPD cop, hunting down dangerous drug dealers and busting up drug dens. On 9/11, he helped evacuate hundreds of people from one of the buildings just before it collapsed. Since that day, he's been battling cancer and Ground Zero Lung from the toxic fumes. We really thought Anthony had been through the worst of it. **Then he took a police job in a small South Carolina town so he could spend his golden years close to his grandkids.** How could I have known he was about to face the greatest danger of his life? I'm not talking about a drug dealer or a terrorist or even cancer... **...but a local prosecutor hellbent on destroying my brother for defending himself when he was the victim of a road rage incident.** Let me explain. The day Anthony was attacked, he was off duty. He and his wife had stopped for lunch after spending the morning at a "Coffee With A Cop" community event. As they tried to pull out of the crowded restaurant parking lot, another driver jumped out of his car and began screaming threats at my brother. **Anthony tried to calm him down.** **But the man attacked him, striking him over and over.** Anthony pulled out his badge and told the man he was under arrest. Instead of complying, the man knocked the badge out of Anthony's hand, got in his car, and tried to flee... ...dragging my brother with his vehicle and running over his legs. In that moment, Anthony knew he was about to be crushed to death in front of his own wife. So he fired a single shot into his attacker's arm, bringing the car to a stop. Anthony's quick thinking saved his life. But the road rage driver who attacked him died at the scene. When I got the call that Anthony had been assaulted and was in the hospital with serious injuries, I was so relieved he was alive. **But my relief turned into shock when my brother was arrested and charged with murder.** He hadn't even recovered from his injuries when the local prosecutor dragged him in front of a judge and had him locked up in jail. And now he's facing up to **30 years** in prison. Anthony is 64 years old. If he's convicted... **...he'll likely spend the rest of his life locked up - and die in prison - for defending himself.** **[That's why I'm writing you - someone I've never met - to ask you to help my brother.](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABl7ImQiOjUwNTEsInQiOjc2NywicyI6MTJ9AAwAAAAAA_D_xcBitRnk8HsFKhTLBMXhIdDDQymcA7kceTLP-lTudM08-xqdP77FKsbrbMnsRnUiPfuejBnMcTqFg7IcKQK5yVbycOyh3hJHyQrryw)** Anthony doesn't deserve this. He served as a cop for four decades and never once faced discipline. He has a spotless record full of awards and commendations. Several years ago, Anthony and his wife took their two granddaughters into their home. They've been raising them ever since. You can imagine the pain it's caused these poor girls to have their grandfather locked up and treated like a common criminal. We were almost out of hope. And then we found out about the **Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund**. LELDF is a national group that's helped dozens of innocent officers clear their names when they're wrongly accused by radical prosecutors. And they've agreed to help Anthony too. Not only are they getting my brother the legal defense he deserves - they're also raising money to pay for the best attorneys and expert witnesses available. Which brings me to the reason I wrote you today: **[Will you help my brother fight these unjust charges by donating to the LELDF?](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABl7ImQiOjUwNTEsInQiOjc2NywicyI6MTJ9AAwAAAAAA_D_xcBj7yKoDD9dTe8sJVTB-cPrgfRcAfu7Dxbk4uUD16qDuJsY5e8SCVkAPdQGAWvv6BhM__rrOnCPDfiDXHyXkXMvqJnSaR0pUP88SQ)** The legal bills are already overwhelming. And we haven't even gotten to trial. Anthony and his wife have already drained almost their entire life's savings fighting to free him. So any amount you can give today will help. And because LELDF is a non-profit organization, your gift is completely tax-deductible. **Whatever you can afford to give, I'm asking you to please make your gift today.** After four decades serving his community, the cancer, and the injuries from his attack, Anthony deserves to spend his retirement years in peace with his family - NOT locked up behind bars for the rest of his life. But that's exactly what will happen unless patriots like you step up on his behalf. Thank you for taking the time to read my email today. **Thank you in advance for making your tax-deductible gift to help Anthony fight to clear his name.** And please, keep my brother in your prayers.
---
| | | **_Frank DeLustro_**
---
P.S. Anthony didn’t know it at the time, but the road-rage maniac who attacked him had a criminal record. Maybe that’s why he was so eager to flee the scene after my brother arrested him. **Please help save Anthony from spending the rest of his life behind bars. Make a tax-deductible gift of any amount to the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund right away.**
---

He hadn't even recovered from his injuries when the local prosecutor dragged him in front of a judge and had him locked up in jail. And now he's facing up to 30 years in prison. Anthony is 64 years old. If he's convicted... ...he'll likely spend the rest of his life locked up - and die in prison - for defending himself. Anthony doesn't deserve this. He served as a cop for four decades and never once faced discipline. He has a spotless record full of awards and commendations. Several years ago, Anthony and his wife took their two granddaughters into their home. They've been raising them ever since. You can imagine the pain it's caused these poor girls to have their grandfather locked up and treated like a common criminal. We were almost out of hope. And then we found out about the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund. LELDF is a national group that's helped dozens of innocent officers clear their names when they're wrongly accused by radical prosecutors. And they've agreed to help Anthony too. Not only are they getting my brother the legal defense he deserves - they're also raising money to pay for the best attorneys and expert witnesses available. Which brings me to the reason I wrote you today: The legal bills are already overwhelming. And we haven't even gotten to trial. Anthony and his wife have already drained almost their entire life's savings fighting to free him. So any amount you can give today will help. And because LELDF is a non-profit organization, your gift is completely tax-deductible. Whatever you can afford to give, I'm asking you to please make your gift today. After four decades serving his community, the cancer, and the injuries from his attack, Anthony deserves to spend his retirement years in peace with his family - NOT locked up behind bars for the rest of his life. But that's exactly what will happen unless patriots like you step up on his behalf. Thank you for taking the time to read my email today. Thank you in advance for making your tax-deductible gift to help Anthony fight to clear his name. And please, keep my brother in your prayers. | | | Frank DeLustro P.S. Anthony didn’t know it at the time, but the road-rage maniac who attacked him had a criminal record. Maybe that’s why he was so eager to flee the scene after my brother arrested him. Please help save Anthony from spending the rest of his life behind bars. Make a tax-deductible gift of any amount to the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund right away. | | More such officers who sacrifice so much for will face similar fates unless we speak out and stand up for the brave men and women in blue. The next time you see a police officer in your community, please thank them for their service. To read more about our mission or the other Law Enforcement officers we're defending, please visit www.leldf.org. subject: Taking stock of everything

body:
#
Peter —
20 years ago, VoteVets was founded with one mission: To take back power for Veterans.
There was no political operation of scale and strength that could recruit and support Veterans in races from coast-to-coast, in every state of our nation. We built that operation from scratch, and Tuesday’s results were decades in the making.
**VoteVets and Democratic Veterans led the charge to take out MAGA Republicans in a generational wipeout election.**
On Day Zero of the Iran War, VoteVets was the first single-issue advocacy organization to spotlight the economic implications of the war. It worked: Just yesterday, Trump and JD Vance said the #1 reason they lost was because of the war.
VoteVets spent the most in our organization’s history to win this midterm election.
* We helped elect 11 new Democrats in pivotal House races (and counting). We invested in races that Washington counted out — and we won.

* We spent more than $25 million in Iowa with our partners to help Josh Turek deliver the majority-making seat for Democrats.

* We endorsed 311 down-ballot races that flipped statehouses in places like New Hampshire.

Make no mistake: VoteVets was on the ballot this Tuesday. VoteVets members won in races no other candidate could. Your support helped us take an active part in elections like Josh Turek, Cait Conley, Elaine Luria, and everyone else who won. It has a bigger impact than you expect.
So thank you for your support, Peter. And as much as we would like to sit back, we already have our next fight brewing.
**The next vote on the Arc de Trump is later today.** A federal commission filled with Trump appointees will decide whether to give final approval on his 250-foot tall monument right outside the gates of Arlington Cemetery.
_There’s a reason why they scheduled this vote right after the election: They’re hoping you’re too distracted to notice._
Look, we know how annoying it is to get a political email right after the election. In a perfect world, we wouldn’t have to send any.
But VoteVets is proudly powered by grassroots supporters like you. It’s thanks to your support that we ALREADY made history on Tuesday. Now, we are doing everything we can to make this backfire on Trump and MAGA Republicans one last time.
[**If you still have some fight left in you, we hope you’ll consider making a donation of $5 to help VoteVets stop this arch today. Nothing would make Trump angrier than a huge amount of people still stepping up.**](https://act.votevets.org/go/2927?c0=vv-pac-em-nov26.ldComW&refcode=em261105-1-misc&t=1&akid=35787%2E3013755%2EQEUBjv)

body:
Tuesday night was a political earthquake.

# [](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/144?t=2&akid=1408%2E61531%2E2DJ0eO)
Hi there,
Tuesday night was a political earthquake. Come January, Democrats will have control of both the House AND the Senate.
The election was one of the greatest rejections of a party in power in living memory. It was made possible by each and every one of you who volunteered, donated, talked to your neighbors, and most importantly, voted.
The American people made it clear they’re outraged by the fact that they work hard every day and still struggle to pay their bills at the end of the month. Meanwhile, they turn on the TV and see Donald Trump bragging about the billions he’s personally pocketed from the presidency, and see headlines about record profits for corporations and tax cuts for billionaires.
We must be clear though: while Tuesday’s tsunami is a repudiation of Donald Trump and congressional Republicans, it isn’t a mandate for Democrats either. This is an opportunity for us to earn the public’s trust by making real progress on issues they care about–first and foremost, bringing down the cost of living.
Even with Donald Trump still in the White House, we must work to lower the cost of health care, lower the cost of energy bills, lower the cost of groceries, and more. That work starts now.
This election is evidence that even when the world around us can seem hopeless, fighting for what’s right is always worth it.
Thank you,
Peter

Friend,

The traffickers think he’s one of their customers.

He isn’t.

He goes by Tracker. In his line of work, he can’t use his real name.

For years, Tracker has worked deep undercover inside the sex trafficking networks run by Mexican cartels. He poses as a buyer and befriends the traffickers. He waits for the moment they trust him.

In his words, “Once they trust you, they start offering you girls.”

Friend, that’s when Tracker’s real mission begins.

Inside those brothels, strip clubs, and massage parlors are girls who were taken at 12, 14, or 16 years old.

Many were stolen from their families while trying to cross the border. Their parents were told the police had stopped the car and immigration had taken their daughter.

They never heard from her again.

These girls are forced to serve as many as 30 or 40 men in a single night. They’re promised freedom once they “pay off” $50,000 or $100,000.

But that goal line always moves.

And Tracker says this isn’t only happening south of the border. It’s happening in Texas... San Francisco... New York... Las Vegas... and elsewhere across America.

Tracker has to reach these girls without harming them and without raising suspicion.

One method he can share: he gives a victim a cell phone. To the traffickers, it’s just a gift from a customer.

In reality, it’s often what cracks the case wide open, giving authorities what they need to take down the entire ring.

By his count, Tracker has helped free more than 200 survivors.

And Friend, that’s why I’m writing to you today, even though you may not know me yet. I’m Jeff Tiegs.

I spent more than three decades in U.S. Army Special Operations as an Army Ranger, a Special Forces Green Beret, and a Delta Force commander, leading intelligence-driven operations around the world.

As a Green Beret, I lived by the words “Free the Oppressed.” At Delta Force: “Oppressors Beware.”

Today, I lead Rescue in Blue, where I put those words to work for children still waiting to be found. Here’s what we do:

Undercover work like Tracker’s only becomes a rescue when trained officers are ready to act on it.

But most local police departments have never been trained to recognize trafficking, even when it’s happening in their own communities.

At Rescue in Blue, we change that.

We equip law enforcement officers and partners like Tracker with the specialized training... technology... and operational support they need to identify victims... arrest predators... and build cases that bring traffickers to justice.

Our three-day Training Camp and Operation Rescue puts experienced military and intelligence professionals alongside local law enforcement to prepare them for one mission:

Finding children who desperately need someone to come for them.

So far, people who share your concern have helped us:

Train more than 9,200 officers...

Support the arrest of 398 predators...

And recover 183 trafficking victims who now have the chance to rebuild their lives.

This is the kind of operation your support makes possible.

But Tracker can’t do this alone. And right now, girls are being held in places he hasn’t found yet, still waiting for someone to come.

That’s why we need YOU, Friend.

Friends, New Yorkers have spoken, and I respect their decision. I want to start with two words: THANK YOU. I could not have asked for better people beside me. Thank you to our volunteers. You knocked on doors in the cold, made calls after long workdays, and gave up your weekends for a cause you believed in. You carried this campaign. Thank you to our campaign team. You worked around the clock, took on a machine that had twenty years of comfort, and never stopped believing. I am proud of every one of you. Thank you to everyone who chipped in. Every $10 and every $25 told me you were in this fight with me. I never took a single dollar for granted. Thank you to every voter who trusted us. You heard our message, and you stood with it. I am humbled by all of you. George Washington lost New York in 1776. He rode back down Broadway into a free city seven years later, on Evacuation Day. Losing a battle is not the same as losing the cause. Our cause has not changed. Every dollar Albany spends belongs to the people who earned it. New Yorkers still deserve a Comptroller who protects their retirement, their tax dollars, and their future. I came here at seven on a fishing boat. I learned that you get back up in America. This is not the last you will see of me.

**These victories didn't happen by accident.**

Because of grassroots supporters like you, VPP was able to stand behind voting rights champions in some of the toughest races in the country.

And we're not done yet! With ballots still being counted across the country, several more VPP-endorsed candidates remain in contention. We're keeping a close eye on those races as we await the final results.

**On Tuesday, our investments paid off. But we're not stopping here.**

body:
# [](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/3095?t=1&akid=5808%2E35263%2ElGux6F)
Peter,
What a night!
I hope you’ve all had the chance to take a deep breath and celebrate the incredible wins from Election Night. I know I’m still smiling!
[](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/6050?c0=em-ms-tb-20261105-reflection.VmdU-i&amount=10&refcode=&t=2&akid=5808%2E35263%2ElGux6F)
Democrats have won back the House and Senate and Wisconsin led the way. I’m so proud to welcome Rebecca Cooke and Mitchell Berman to Congress and to celebrate so many historic firsts across Wisconsin and the country.
Right here at home, David Crowley will lead our great state as our next governor. With a Democratic legislature behind him, we have a real opportunity to roll up our sleeves and start building a better future for Wisconsin families. After a decade of gerrymandered gridlock, Wisconsin finally has a government that reflects the will of its voters. Now we can expand BadgerCare, fully fund our public schools, make child care affordable, and protect reproductive freedom in law. This is what years of organizing looks like.
**You made that possible, Peter!**
Together, we chose hope over fear. Voters picked leaders who look like the communities they serve and who are ready to lower costs, protect health care, and hold this administration accountable. I can’t overstate the difference you made.
Every step of the way, supporters like you showed up when it was the most crucial. Whether you knocked on doors, called voters, chipped in a few dollars, all of those actions led us to where we are now. We won this the Wisconsin way.
But these wins aren’t the finish line —**it’s the starting line.** There’s so much good we can do, and I’d be honored to have you with me as we begin this new chapter. **[Will you chip in to help power our work in the Senate for the years ahead?](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/6050?c0=em-ms-tb-20261105-reflection.VmdU-i&amount=10&refcode=em20261105-5808&t=3&akid=5808%2E35263%2ElGux6F)**

Thank you, Wisconsin. 💙
Tammy

## Trump Floats Hegseth for Blackburn's Seat
President Trump said Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth [would be "very popular"](https://email.editor.thetennesseeflyover.com/c/eJyk0LFutDAQBOCnMR0n7wIGChd_Q3d_mxIZvGArxkb2Hpe8fXSnvEHqkWb0zcd9vhsffNz_m4M08zZHepZAzJRnzo_jLI99p8LF0V6I3WdMX9eMElUNUMtuNiv7i-bWVFYvCKNp14o09GMz9GqUsnIaFbbriHZolLVgYMFu6WFRHVhaemsqr1-FALIDkAP0N4l2XMdto7Zpl6ZZRCvJek75xo6YYqRSiLbwnS7KtzUdVdCO-Syi-SdwEjixI-dDeGUCJ5cOesEETsYePvrC2bBPUeCkYBz6QdVvbV0e55kyl_rXW3OsC0XDJHCqsrbn04fgi-pFK_fD-PdExX_87tL4EwAA__9XUoY2) if he filled Marsha Blackburn's U.S. Senate seat, which she'll give up after winning Tennessee's governor's race. Trump said he isn't considering replacing Hegseth after Republicans' midterm losses, though sources reported he has asked advisers whether Hegseth should stay. Friend --
I wanted you to get this update from me: **Ballots are still being counted, and right now, it’s still too close to call.**
We are going to do everything we can to make sure every single vote is counted in this race.
But I’ll be honest: That is going to take time – and plenty of resources that we don’t currently have.
As we fight to make sure every ballot is counted, we’re going to remain the top target of the DC establishment.
We put everything we had into winning this race, so I’m counting on your help to fight back against their attacks.
It looks like we’re in this for the long haul, so I need your help to sustain our fight until every vote is counted.
From the very beginning, this campaign has been powered by grassroots donations from people like you. I’m proud of that fact, but it means it’s going to take lots of us to stand up to their pressure in the coming days.
That’s why I have to ask:
**[If you can afford it today, please pitch in anything you can to my and GIFFORDS PAC at this critical moment. It all adds up to help us keep fighting.](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giff-em-peltola26.UWc08j&refcode=em261105-1-B&t=2&akid=12005%2E3935704%2EVBo9nB)**

Thank you, and more soon.
Mary
